|game_text=May be stacked on [[I Know That Laugh]] from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-76-Rennek.png]]). The current text is [[Rennek (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 4, slip 19 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.” The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rennek (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “from hand, using 2 Force” to “from hand for 2 force” and “reset” to “reduce”<ref name="cl-1282_19-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012, before Virtual Block 8.2)</ref>: “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand for 2 force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reduce a participating character's forfeit to 0.” The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rennek (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 14)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=14, page 14. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=14 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.” '''What changed:''' “using 2 Force” and “reset a participating character's forfeit to 0” again, for the card list's “for 2 force” and “reduce a participating character's forfeit to 0”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; like the slip, it prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rennek (V) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-rennek-pre.gif]]) prints: “May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the card image prints the Master List words exactly. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual8-Light) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 7 May 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual8-Light">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual8-Light/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 7 May 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the Master List (27 April 2013), so it is the latest publication and the current text. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card plays these words: Rennek may reset the forfeit of a participating character whose forfeit may not be reduced; this reverses the confirmation of 9 November 2026 (Batch B22) that it plays the card-list wording (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
